description: This file defines an abstract class 'SiloHandle' that represents a handle to a remotely deployed silo in Orleans testing environment. It includes properties for configuration, address, and status, as well as asynchronous and synchronous disposal methods and abstract methods for stopping the silo.

classes.name: SiloHandle
classes.description: An abstract class representing a handle to a remote Orleans silo, providing lifecycle management and status properties.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Performs application-defined tasks associated with freeing resources, calls virtual Dispose(bool), and suppresses finalization.

methods.name: Dispose(bool)
methods.description: Virtual method for disposing managed resources, optionally stopping the silo asynchronously if active.

methods.name: StopSiloAsync(bool)
methods.description: Abstract method to asynchronously stop the silo, with a parameter indicating graceful shutdown.

methods.name: StopSiloAsync(CancellationToken)
methods.description: Abstract method to asynchronously stop the silo with a cancellation token.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Abstract method for asynchronously disposing resources.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the silo address.
